customManagers.description: Images pinned by tag and digest, as quoted strings, in the workflows and scripts.

packageRules.description: Hermes releases are tagged vYYYY.M.D (sometimes with a fourth part); each one waits for approval.
signal-cli must stay current because Signal retires old clients. GHCR gives Renovate no release dates, so a minimum release age cannot hold new releases back; each one waits for approval instead.
The distroless base is resolved to its current digest at each build, so it is not pinned here.
New digests of the Debian image used by the daily check, merged once the tag has gone seven days without a new push. Docker Hub's push date is the release date, so a re-push restarts the wait.
Pinned GitHub Actions, merged once a release is at least seven days old.
